title: Learning to Extract Context for Context-Aware LLM Inference
reasoning: The paper focuses on Large Language Model safety and the mitigation of harmful responses. It evaluates its methodology using datasets specifically designed to benchmark safety and ethical compliance, such as SafetyInstruct, Advbench, and Wildjailbreak. These benchmarks test the model's ability to correctly identify and refuse harmful or unethical requests (e.g., concerning illegal activities or dangerous behavior) while maintaining helpfulness for benign ones.
